title: Vibrant Spicy Spanish Chicken Paella
description: A sour and light Spanish dish featuring dark brown sugar and bhuna, perfect for a lazy Sunday, and Whole30 friendly.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the pan and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, black pepper, and bhuna spice blend to the pan and cook for 1 minute.
Add the dark brown sugar, lemon juice, and chicken broth to the pan and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the cauliflower rice to the pan and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the cauliflower rice is tender.
Serve the paella hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
